observations: One perspective room scene. Light enters at the left shutter/window, travels diagonally to a small triangular prism on a central support, and fans toward the opposite wall.

The receiving wall has a vertically elongated stack of partly overlapping round or foreshortened-round patches. Alternating dark and light rendering distinguishes approximately seven successive image positions; the source is monochrome, not a literal colour reproduction.
Several solid fan boundaries connect the prism region to the wall patches. The shared incident beam and diverging output, not room furniture, are instructional structure.
No printed colour names, point letters, numerical measurements, equations, axes or grid are visible.
The window, door, floorboards, ceiling, chairs, table and shading establish a dark-room setting but do not add measured optical constraints.
editionRequirements: Retain round-hole input, prism refraction, an elongated wall spectrum and visibly overlapping circular images.
The seven conventional names describe positions in a gradually varying spectrum; do not replace the circular-image overlap with seven disconnected strips.

observations: One shared optical frame ordered left to right: opening in an opaque vertical slit plate, upright thin convex lens, apex-up triangular prism with horizontal base, upright receiving screen.
Upper and lower solid rays leave the slit toward upper and lower lens positions, with rightward arrowheads. A horizontal central reference runs from slit to screen.
Dashed continuations of the upper and lower lens routes converge at the same upper screen position on the central reference. These represent the undispersed slit image without the prism.

The upper solid route meets the prism near its apex; the lower route enters the left face below it. Solid dispersed paths emerge toward two screen positions below the undispersed image, with rightward arrows.

The upper dispersed screen position is labelled red in Chinese and the lower is labelled violet in Chinese. No other colour names, numbers, measured angles, point letters, equations, axes or grid appear.
Oblique prism hatch strokes depict glass schematically, not a measurement or an extra optical route.
editionRequirements: Retain slit/lens/prism/screen order and common contacts, red less deviated than violet, and both dispersed destinations below the no-prism image.
Make dashed no-prism references unambiguously distinct from solid dispersed paths; show slit imaging rather than only a generic ray fan.
